scope.summary: Create non-breaking cloud/cloud-os and cloud/cloud-kernel landing-zone scaffolds using machine-readable manifests only; no source Markdown is added.
explicit_non_claims: No infra/talos runtime files moved or modified.
No cloud/cloud-k8s assets moved or modified.
No node OS image, kernel source, module build, installer, Kubernetes control-plane change, live infrastructure, or production readiness claim.
No Markdown source files are introduced; human-readable docs, if needed, must be derived from the JSON manifests outside the source artifact set.

facets.F1_correctness: Scaffolds align with the current consolidation map: OS -> cloud/cloud-os, kernel -> cloud/cloud-kernel, Kubernetes remains cloud/cloud-k8s; a fresh repo scan found no existing node-os destination to reuse.
facets.F2_tests: JSON manifests/evidence parse; scm-facts and accounting faces regenerated from the final tree; no added Markdown diff is allowed.
facets.F3_maintainability: Single machine-readable manifest per landing zone; no parallel README/ARCH Markdown drift surface.
facets.F4_compatibility: No existing runtime paths moved; existing infra/talos and cloud/cloud-k8s left untouched.
facets.F5_security: No secrets, credentials, signing material, or runtime deployment introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant data or personal data fields/processors introduced.
facets.F7_operability: Manifests explicitly mark runtime/SLO/DR/audit emission as non-claimed scaffold-only; cloud-ci remains the hermetic productized enforcement surface.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime path added; capacity fields are explicit zero/non-runtime placeholders.
facets.F9_compliance: ADR references and non-claim posture preserve substrate/control-plane separation.
facets.F10_reversibility: All changes are additive JSON scaffolds plus regenerated accounting/scm faces and can be reverted as one PR.
facets.F11_observability: No observability runtime claimed; audit evidence file records change scope.
facets.F13_migration: Creates future consolidation landing zones without migrating infra/talos or cloud/cloud-k8s assets; node-os alternate was checked and found absent in origin/dev.

known_gaps: Tracking issue #617 exists and PR #618 references it; this evidence records that issue linkage after PR creation.
Reviewer approval remains pending until final rebased PR evidence and remote CI complete.
GitHub Actions Node20 checkout warnings are adapter hygiene and are tracked separately from this scaffold.
hyperscaler_lens: Destination names and evidence are canonical, machine-readable, hermetic-CI enforced, and safe for reuse as public cloud-native project scaffolding patterns.
